name: Error-Guided Sparse Pixel Sampling
definition: A training scheme that restricts loss evaluation and gradient computation to a sparse subset of pixels per tile, guided by persistent error and age maps, to reallocate computation from well-reconstructed regions to informative pixels.
summary: Error-Guided Sparse Pixel Sampling accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting by restricting loss evaluation to a sparse subset of pixels per tile, guided by persistent error and age maps.
